footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Eversource: after $7.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 13.8% to $13.5B in 2025. Operating income rose 24.1% to $3.0B, a 22.1% margin.
Net income rose 2.1× to $1.7B, or $4.56 per share. Operating cash flow was $4.1B and free cash flow −$45.1M, versus −$2.3B; Eversource returned $1.1B through dividends.
sources: Eversource Energy Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
